<thought>Analyzing the provided mass spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart with intensities following a binomial distribution (100 → ~10 → ~1 → ~0.1 → ...). This pattern is characteristic of the natural 13C isotopic distribution in a carbon‑containing molecule. No other element shows its distinctive isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
